bugs.component: graph/GraphCanvas.tsx (fit, ResizeObserver, d3-zoom extent); ui/kit.tsx (Reveal, CountUp)
bugs.title: Lab graph and scroll-revealed sections render blank when the page is mounted in a zero-size or non-painting viewport (e.g. the hidden embedded browser pane)
bugs.preconditions: API running on :8000. Page loaded while its viewport has no size or does not paint (embedded browser pane hidden/minimised; background tab; a collapsed iframe).
steps: Open http://localhost:8000/lab in the embedded browser pane while the pane is hidden (or emulate a 1x1 viewport over CDP).
Inspect `.graph-svg > g` and the page sections.
Navigate to /theory and inspect the opacity of the <Reveal> sections below the first two.
On /, read the four KPI values.
bugs.expected: The 48 states are drawn at a readable scale as soon as the graph is visible; content does not depend on animation frames or scroll position to become visible; KPIs show their real values.
bugs.actual: In the hidden pane: innerWidth=innerHeight=0, requestAnimationFrame fires 0 times/s, the graph group transform is `translate(0,310) scale(0)` (all 48 nodes and 89 edges exist in the DOM but are drawn at zero size), KPIs read `0 | 0 | 0 | 0`. A wheel event while collapsed produces `translate(Infinity,Infinity) scale(0.2)`. On /theory, 5 of 7 <Reveal> sections stay at opacity 0 until scrolled into view. The homepage hero graph is unaffected because it is a viewBox-scaled SVG with no measured fit — which matches the report that the automaton 'shows on the homepage but not in other sections'.
evidence: embedded pane probe: {innerWidth:0, rafFramesIn1s:0, gTransform:'translate(0,310) scale(0)', nodes:48, edges:89}
In a visible 1440x900 headless Edge the same page renders correctly (qa/evidence/02_lab.json) and recovers after a resize (A_after_resize).
bugs.root_cause: Established for the mechanism, highly likely for the user's report: GraphCanvas computes the fit from the container's clientWidth (0 → k=0) and d3-zoom's extent [[0,0],[w,h]] with w=0 (→ Infinity); Reveal/CountUp/page transitions need IntersectionObserver + requestAnimationFrame to reach their final state. The homepage graph uses a fixed viewBox instead.
bugs.recommended_fix: Never fit when w<=0 or h<=0 (skip and retry on the next ResizeObserver tick); clamp k to the zoom scaleExtent; guard the zoom extent against zero size; render the SVG with a viewBox fallback so it is visible before measurement. Make Reveal render visible content by default (animate only an enhancement; no opacity:0 initial state when IntersectionObserver is unavailable or when printing). Render scientific KPI values as final numbers (see DATA-001).
regression_tests: vitest: GraphCanvas mounted with clientWidth 0 never produces scale(0)/NaN/Infinity and fits once a width appears.
vitest: Reveal children are visible (opacity 1) when IntersectionObserver is undefined.
CDP/Playwright: load /lab at 1x1, resize to 1440x900, assert ≥48 visible nodes; wheel at 1x1 then resize, assert finite transform.

fix.summary: GraphCanvas never fits into a container without size, clamps the scale, ignores degenerate zoom transforms and refits when a size appears; Reveal/page transitions/count-ups no longer start hidden.
fix.verified_by: fixes.test.tsx 'never produces a degenerate transform…'; tools/08 (no animation frames, 1x1 → 1440x900)

bugs.title: Replay and μ̂ estimate are computed for the current form values, not for the trajectory on screen
steps: Open /explorer, keep seed 5, press 'Sample failed trajectory' (5 steps: PLAN_START>…>PLAN_SUBGOAL_WRONG).
Change Seed to 11 but do NOT resample.
With step 4 selected press 'Run one counterfactual replay' (same for 'Estimate μt', or after changing Intervention / Fault probability).
bugs.expected: The replay uses the parameters of the loaded trajectory (seed 5, its eps_plan and intervention), or the stale form is clearly flagged and the action disabled until resampling.
bugs.actual: Request body is {seed: 11, arm: 3, ...}. The 'Original run' column of the replay shows a different 13-step trajectory (PLAN_START>PLAN_DECOMP>…>MEM_CORRUPT) while the chart and step list still show the seed-5 trajectory; the arm index is applied to the wrong trajectory (and can be out of range → 422).
bugs.root_cause: `const body = { source, seed, eps_plan: eps, intervention: interv, deterministic: det }` is rebuilt on every render from the live form state and reused by doReplay/doEstimate.
bugs.recommended_fix: Store the request parameters together with the loaded trajectory (e.g. `loaded = {params, traj}`) and use `loaded.params` for replay/estimate. When the form differs from `loaded.params`, show a 'parameters changed — resample' notice and disable replay/estimate (or resample automatically).
regression_tests: vitest: load seed 5, change seed to 11, click replay → POST /api/replay body has seed 5 (or the button is disabled with a notice).
vitest: same for estimate and for intervention / eps changes.

fix.summary: The explorer stores the exact parameters of the loaded trajectory; replays and estimates use them, a notice shows when the form differs.
fix.verified_by: fixes.test.tsx 'replays with the parameters of the sampled trajectory'

bugs.title: Path traversal: the SPA catch-all serves any file outside website/dist
steps: curl --path-as-is http://localhost:8000/../../pyproject.toml
Repeat with /..%2F..%2Fpyproject.toml, /%2e%2e/%2e%2e/pyproject.toml, /..%5C..%5Cpyproject.toml
bugs.expected: 404 (or index.html) for every path that resolves outside website/dist.
bugs.actual: HTTP 200, application/octet-stream, 926 B: the project's pyproject.toml. Any readable file on the machine reachable by relative path can be served (the auditor read only pyproject.toml).
bugs.root_cause: `f = DIST / full_path; if f.is_file(): return FileResponse(f)` with no check that f.resolve() is inside DIST.
bugs.recommended_fix: Resolve the candidate and require `f.resolve().is_relative_to(DIST.resolve())`; otherwise fall back to index.html (or 404). Do not serve dotfiles. Keep the server bound to 127.0.0.1.
regression_tests: pytest (TestClient): GET '/../../pyproject.toml', '/..%2F..%2Fpyproject.toml', '/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/pyproject.toml', '/..%5C..%5Cpyproject.toml' never return pyproject content.
pytest: GET '/assets/<real file>' and '/lab' still work.

fix.summary: The static fallback resolves the path and serves only files inside website/dist; unknown /api and /files paths are 404.

bugs.title: Replay endpoints return HTTP 500 for out-of-range input instead of 422
steps: POST /api/replay {"seed":-1,"arm":0}
POST /api/replay {"seed":0,"arm":0,"n_states":500}  (also n_states 10, eps_plan 1.5)
POST /api/replay/estimate {"seed":-3,"arm":0,"n":10}
bugs.expected: 422 with a readable field message (as /api/trajectory does for the same values).
bugs.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (text/plain). Traceback in results/processed/api_err.txt: pydantic ValidationError for AttribReq.seed.
evidence: 5 probes → 500; /api/trajectory {seed:-1} → 422 'Input should be greater than or equal to 0'
bugs.root_cause: ReplayReq has unconstrained seed/n_states/eps_plan; the handler builds AttribReq(...) inside the request, whose ValidationError is not converted to an HTTP error.
bugs.recommended_fix: Give ReplayReq the same Field constraints as TrajReq/AttribReq (seed ge=0, n_states 48..96, eps_plan [0,1)); additionally catch pydantic.ValidationError/ValueError around build_env and return 422.
regression_tests: pytest: each of the 5 bodies above returns 422 with a field name in detail.
pytest: no endpoint returns 500 for a sweep of invalid bodies (property test over fields).

fix.summary: Bounds on every replay/estimate/trace field and a handler turning pydantic errors raised inside handlers into 422.

bugs.title: Probabilistic automaton shows 'accepted'/'rejected' from one sampled run
steps: Open /lab?model=pa, word 'go', press Run trace.
bugs.expected: Acceptance is reported as a probability (exact P(accept), Monte-Carlo estimate); the sampled path is labelled 'one sampled run ended in t (accepting)', not 'accepted'.
bugs.actual: Badges: 'accepted' + 'exact P(accept) = 0.7000' + 'Monte-Carlo 0.705 [0.685, 0.725]'. Re-running can flip the badge to 'rejected' for the same word.

vitest: PA result shows probability badges and no 'accepted' badge.

bugs.title: Mealy and Moore transducers are reported as 'accepted'

bugs.title: PDA rejections return an empty trace, so the user cannot see where the run failed
steps: Open /lab?model=pda, enter 'call ret ret' (or 'call'), press Run trace.
Open pda_typed, enter 'open_search end_calc'.
bugs.expected: Steps up to the failing configuration (stack underflow / type mismatch / non-empty stack at end) with the stack shown, plus the reason for rejection.
bugs.actual: Response {accepted:false, steps:[]}. UI shows only a 'rejected' badge, playback controls disappear and the hint 'Press Run trace to execute the model…' reappears as if nothing ran.

bugs.recommended_fix: Return the longest explored configuration sequence (or the deterministic prefix) with a `reject_reason` (no transition / stack mismatch / stack not empty); show it in the stack panel. Show a 'run finished: rejected' state instead of the initial hint.
regression_tests: pytest: pda trace for ['call','ret','ret'] has ≥2 steps and reject_reason.
vitest: rejected PDA run keeps playback and shows the reason.

fix.summary: A rejected PDA run returns the furthest computation and a reason (underflow, mismatch, unclosed call); the UI keeps playback and the stack.

bugs.title: The 48-state 'DFA' view is not total and hides the sink it claims to add
steps: Open /lab, Formalism view = DFA.
Compare with m.to_dfa(): 49 states (incl. ⊥sink), 2009 transitions over 41 symbols.
bugs.expected: A DFA view consistent with the definition shown (δ total): either draw the sink (collapsed, e.g. 'all other symbols → ⊥') or label the view 'partial deterministic skeleton (sink omitted)'.
bugs.actual: Graph shows 48 nodes and 48 edges (one per (state, action)); the callout says 'The DFA view adds an explicit sink that is not counted' but no sink is drawn; the definition says δ is total.

bugs.recommended_fix: Return the sink node (flag `sink: true`, excluded from the logical count) and one aggregated edge per state 'Σ∖{a} → ⊥'; update the callout to match.
regression_tests: pytest: dfa view has a sink node and every non-sink state has an explicit default edge; count_logical_states stays 48.
vitest: DFA view legend/callout mention the drawn sink.

fix.summary: The 48-state DFA view draws the explicit sink with one aggregated default edge per state; the logical count stays 48.

bugs.title: Requirement: states must use q0, q1, … naming and every model must demonstrate all relevant cases
bugs.preconditions: User requirement (stated in this audit request).
steps: Open each model in /lab and read the state ids.
bugs.expected: Every model uses q-indexed state ids (q0, q1, …; 48-state model q0…q47) with the descriptive name as a secondary label, and each model shows its full set of cases (accept, reject, dead/trap state, empty word, invalid symbol; NFA active sets; ε-closure; PDA push/pop/reject; TM accept/reject/step-limit).
bugs.actual: Only NFA and ε-NFA use q0…; DFA uses even/odd, PA s/t/f, LTS idle/thinking…, Mealy idle/calling/retrying, Moore product names 'idle/start', PDA q/acc, TM scan/carry/done/acc/rej, TM_pal has_a/go_a…, 48-state model PLAN_START…FAIL_TOOL. Toy models are minimal (DFA 2 states without a dead state; PA single-letter alphabet; PDA 2 states; no NFA→DFA subset-construction view although the backend implements and tests it; no TM step-limit demo).
bugs.root_cause: Design choice; not a defect in execution.
bugs.recommended_fix: Add a stable `qid` (q0…) to every node in the API (keep `id` semantic for back-compat or switch id→qid and move names to `label`), display 'q3 · Select subgoal' in nodes and tables; extend examples: DFA with a dead state (e.g. 3–4 states), NFA→DFA subset construction view, ε-NFA→NFA conversion, PA with ≥2 symbols and a rejecting sink, PDA with an explicit reject path, TM with a step-limit 'unknown' example. Keep the 48 logical-state count unchanged (do not add states to reach a number).

fix.verified_by: test_api_automata.py (every example executed); tools/08 (all example cases)

bugs.title: For threshold targets the stopping-rule panel and the correctness badge use the argmax rule
steps: Open /dashboard, Target = 'Latest step ≥ θ (CAR locus)', θ = 0.5, Run attribution.
bugs.expected: Panel shows the threshold rule state (which steps are certified above/below θ) and correctness against the threshold target's true answer.
bugs.actual: Outcome 'culprit certified' with badge 'matches exact argmax', while the stopping card says 'best t=1: lo = 0.005 · strongest challenger t=2: hi = 1.000 · separation margin −0.995 · negative margin: intervals still overlap' — contradicting the certified outcome.
bugs.root_cause: `stats` (h, ℓ, margin) and `correct` are computed with argmax-ε logic regardless of res.target.name.
bugs.recommended_fix: Branch on res.target.name: for first/last_above compute per-arm status (lo ≥ θ certified above, hi < θ certified below, undecided) and compare the answer with the true first/last index ≥ θ from ground_truth; hide the argmax margin.
regression_tests: vitest: last_above result renders threshold status and no 'separation margin'; badge compares with the threshold truth.

fix.summary: Threshold targets get their own panel (above / below / undecided per step, θ line on the forest plot) and are judged against the threshold answer.

bugs.title: Result panels read the live form instead of the run that produced them
steps: Run attribution with budget 20000 (6089 rollouts → 'budget used 30%').
Change Rollout budget to 100000 without re-running.
Change seed and press 'Run uniform on this instance'.
bugs.expected: Budget used, budget text and the uniform comparison refer to the completed run's configuration ('identical instance and seed').
bugs.actual: 'Budget used' changes to 6% and the Rollouts card says 'budget 100,000' for a 20,000-budget run; compare() calls api.attribute(req(...)) with the current form, so after a seed change the 'identical instance' comparison runs on a different instance.
bugs.root_cause: Displays and compare() use component state (budget, seed, …) rather than parameters stored with `res`.
bugs.recommended_fix: Store the request with the result (`run = {req, res}`), compute displays from run.req and build the uniform comparison from run.req; mark results 'stale' when the form changes.
regression_tests: vitest: changing budget after a run does not change 'budget used'.
vitest: compare after a seed change posts the original seed.

fix.summary: A result is stored with the request that produced it; budget, comparison and summary use that request; a stale notice appears when the form changes.

bugs.title: Homepage metrics are animated count-ups: screenshots and throttled windows show wrong values (the reported 47 / 144 of 146 / 6413)
steps: Load / and sample `.kpis .stat .v` every 60 ms for 0.8 s.
Load / in a hidden pane / background tab.
bugs.expected: Scientific metrics show their exact values (48 · 146 of 146 · 6518 · 0) at all times.
bugs.actual: Timeline at 540 ms: '47 | 143 | 6401 | 0'; final at 720 ms: '48 | 146 | 6518 | 0'. The supplied screenshot's 47 / 144 / 6413 are all ≈98.4 % of the true values (47/48, 144/146, 6413/6518), i.e. one frame of the ease-out animation. In a non-painting pane the values stay at 0. Data sources are correct: API returns count_logical_states=48 (48 unique ids/labels, all reachable), tests 123/123 + 23/23, 6518 rows = sum of the 12 raw CSVs.
evidence: raw CSV row total 6518 == suite_meta sum 6518
bugs.root_cause: Stat renders values through CountUp (0→value over 900 ms via requestAnimationFrame). No state is missing: the 47 is a transient animation frame, not a model defect.
bugs.recommended_fix: Render research metrics as static final values (keep animation, if any, purely decorative and never changing the digits), or snap to the final value on mount and when the document is hidden. Add the test-report timestamp to the tests KPI ('last run 2026-10-24 03:09') because it is read from a stored report, not run live.
regression_tests: vitest: Overview KPI text equals the API values on first render after data arrives (no intermediate numbers).
CDP: screenshot at 300 ms shows 48 / 146 / 6518.

fix.summary: Research numbers are rendered exactly (no count-up animation).

bugs.title: Invalid numeric input is flagged but the run silently uses the previous valid value
steps: Open /dashboard, set Confidence δ to 0 (field shows 'Must be > 0').
Press Run attribution.
bugs.expected: Run is disabled (or blocked with a message) while any field is invalid.
bugs.actual: Run button enabled; request is sent with delta: 0.1 (the last valid value). Same pattern for budget, seed, trials, n.
bugs.root_cause: NumberField only calls onChange for valid values and keeps its error local; parents never learn that a field is invalid.
bugs.recommended_fix: Expose validity (onValidityChange or a form-level error map) and disable submit buttons while invalid; show a summary next to the button.
regression_tests: vitest: δ=0 disables Run attribution and no POST is made.
vitest: same for Studio trials and Explorer n.

fix.summary: A form validity hook disables submit buttons while any number field is invalid, with a message.

bugs.title: CSS uppercase turns δ into Δ and ε into Ε in form labels
steps: Open /dashboard and read the labels 'Confidence δ' and 'Tolerance ε'.
bugs.expected: 'CONFIDENCE δ', 'TOLERANCE ε' (Greek symbols keep their case).
bugs.actual: 'CONFIDENCE Δ' and 'TOLERANCE Ε'. Δ is the paper's symbol for the gap Δ_t = μ_t − μ_ref, so the label now names a different quantity; 'Ε' reads as Latin E.
bugs.root_cause: text-transform: uppercase applies Unicode case mapping to Greek letters.
bugs.recommended_fix: Wrap symbols in <span class='sym'> with text-transform:none (or use font-variant small-caps for labels), or drop uppercase for labels containing math.
regression_tests: vitest/DOM: computed text-transform of .sym is none.
visual: label renders lowercase δ.

fix.summary: Greek symbols in labels keep their case (.sym).

bugs.title: Unknown /api/* paths return 200 index.html, and the client accepts HTML as data
steps: curl -i http://localhost:8000/api/models (also /api/nope, /api/results/groups, /api/figures)
bugs.expected: 404 JSON {detail: 'Not Found'} for any /api/* route that does not exist; the client rejects non-JSON for JSON endpoints.
bugs.actual: 200 text/html (the SPA shell). `request()` returns the HTML string typed as T, so a typo in an endpoint fails later with confusing errors. (The previous session's 'all API endpoints return 200' check used these paths and was therefore a false positive.)
bugs.root_cause: The catch-all route `/{full_path:path}` also matches /api/... and /files/...; request() falls back to res.text() for non-JSON.
bugs.recommended_fix: In spa(): if full_path starts with 'api/' or 'files/' raise HTTPException(404). In request(): for JSON endpoints throw ApiError when content-type is not JSON.
regression_tests: pytest: GET /api/does-not-exist → 404 JSON.
vitest: request() with an HTML 200 response rejects with ApiError.

fix.summary: Unknown /api and /files routes return 404 JSON; the client rejects non-JSON answers from JSON endpoints.

bugs.title: Custom cursor hides the native pointer site-wide and runs a permanent rAF loop
bugs.preconditions: Desktop with a mouse, motion allowed.
steps: Move the mouse; observe styles.css .cursor-on { cursor: none } on the root.
bugs.expected: Native cursor kept (custom ring as decoration) or an opt-out; no work when idle.
bugs.actual: `cursor: none` on html/a/button/label/select/.graph-svg; the ring follows via a requestAnimationFrame loop that never stops. If the loop stalls (throttled/hidden window, heavy main thread) the user sees no pointer.

fix.summary: The native cursor is no longer hidden; the ring is decoration and its animation loop stops when the pointer is idle.

bugs.component: website/src/pages/Lab.tsx trailFromTrace, trailIndex/countUpTo; GraphCanvas current marker
bugs.title: NFA/ε-NFA playback marks a single 'current' state, omits the initial ε-closure and maps steps to edges proportionally
steps: Open /lab?model=enfa, Run trace 'a b', step through; observe step 0 and the cyan 'current' ring.
bugs.expected: At step 0 the active set is ε-closure(q0) = {q0,q1,q2}; each step highlights exactly the edges taken in that step; there is no single 'current' state for set-based runs.
bugs.actual: Step 0 shows no active set; a cyan pulse marks one state (the last edge's target) as 'current'; edges revealed per step are approximated by ceil(trail.length·idx/steps), which is only correct when every step contributes the same number of edges.
bugs.root_cause: Trail indexing is not per step; GraphCanvas derives `current` from the last revealed edge.
bugs.recommended_fix: Build trail as an array of per-step edge groups; reveal groups[0..idx); pass activeSet (including the initial closure at idx 0) and suppress the single current marker for set semantics.
regression_tests: vitest: ε-NFA idx 0 active set equals closure_steps' last set.
vitest: unequal per-step edge counts highlight exactly the edges of steps ≤ idx.

fix.summary: Playback reveals the edges of each step; NFA/ε-NFA show the active set (including the initial ε-closure) and no single 'current' state.

bugs.title: LTS deadlock / blocked step is not shown

bugs.expected: The third step is shown as blocked at 'done' (no 'plan' transition) — a deadlock for that label.
bugs.actual: Only 'rejected'; the step with blocked:true and next_state:null is silently skipped in playback.
evidence: POST trace lts → steps[2] = {state:'done', symbol:'plan', next_state:null, blocked:true}
bugs.root_cause: trailFromTrace ignores steps whose next_state is not a string; the UI never reads `blocked`.
bugs.recommended_fix: Render a 'blocked at <state> on <label>' badge and highlight the state; list LTS deadlocks from the graph payload (already returned as `deadlocks`).
regression_tests: vitest: blocked LTS step renders a blocked badge.

fix.summary: A blocked LTS step is shown as 'blocked at q3 on plan' with the reason.

bugs.title: API reference drops bounds of 0 (operator precedence) and nullable types
steps: Open /docs → API reference → POST /api/attribute.
bugs.expected: seed '≥ 0', eps_plan '≥ 0, < 1', eps '≥ 0, ≤ 0.5', reconstruct_noise '≥ 0, ≤ 1'.
bugs.actual: seed '—', eps_plan '< 1', eps '≤ 0.5', reconstruct_noise '≤ 1'; nullable fields (anyOf) show type '—'.
bugs.root_cause: `v.minimum ?? v.exclusiveMinimum != null ? … : ''` parses as `(v.minimum ?? (v.exclusiveMinimum != null)) ? …`; a minimum of 0 is falsy.
bugs.recommended_fix: Compute lower = v.exclusiveMinimum ?? v.minimum with explicit `!= null` checks; render anyOf types.
regression_tests: vitest: schema {minimum:0} renders '≥ 0'.

fix.summary: The range column keeps bounds of 0 and nullable types.
fix.verified_by: fixes.test.tsx 'range column keeps bounds of zero'

bugs.title: Graph readability: overlapping edge labels, clipped self-loops, edge labels over node labels, tiny scale for 96 states / mobile
steps: Open /lab?model=moore and Run trace; open tm_pal; open the 48-state model; select 96 states; open /lab at 390×844.
bugs.expected: No overlapping labels; self-loops inside the viewport; readable labels.
bugs.actual: Moore: 11 overlapping edge-label pairs (28 parallel/self edges), self-loop at the top clipped; tm_pal: 2 overlapping pairs; agent graph: edge label 'tool_invalid 0.10' over the node label 'Select tool'; 96 states fit at scale 0.45; at 390 px the 48 nodes are drawn in 318 px.
bugs.root_cause: Layered layout with fixed spacing; parallel edges between the same pair get separate labels; no label collision handling; bbox ignores self-loop height.
bugs.recommended_fix: Merge parallel edges into one edge with a combined label ('task, ok / noop'); include self-loop extents in bbox; offset labels away from nodes / add a label background; for agent48 show labels on hover only and offer a 'columns compact' layout; on mobile default to a list/table view with the graph behind a toggle.
regression_tests: unit (layout): no two label boxes overlap for the bundled models.
CDP: overlappingLabelPairs == 0 for every model.

fix.summary: Parallel edges merged into one arrow with one label; label de-collision; the fit includes label extents; self-loop room.
fix.verified_by: tools/08 (0 overlapping labels, 0 clipped states for every model)

bugs.title: Turing-machine tape window shifts as the head moves; blank symbol differs between backend and UI
steps: Run the TM trace and step through.
bugs.expected: Fixed tape window with cell indices; one blank symbol.
bugs.actual: Visible tape changes between '␣␣1011␣␣␣' and '1011␣␣␣' as the window is recomputed from the head position; backend uses '_' while the UI shows '␣'.
bugs.root_cause: Tape window = [min(0, head−2, keys), max(head+2, keys, 6)] per step.

fix.summary: The tape window is computed once over the whole run.
